name: HRnetGroup Limited
summary: HRnetGroup Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the recruitment and staffing business in Singapore, Hong Kong, Taiwan, the People's Republic of China, Japan, South Korea, Malaysia, Thailand, and Indonesia. The company operates through Professional Recruitment, Flexible Staffing, and Others segments. It offers personnel recruitment and human resource related services; employment, recruitment, and personnel placement agency services; executive search services; permanent recruitment, payroll, and temporary and contracted staffing services; and executive and management recruitment services, as well as management consultancy services. The company serves financial institutions, information technology and telecommunications, retail and consumer, healthcare life science, manufacturing, insurance, logistics, services, education, and other industries. It provides its services under the HRnet One, Recruit Express, PeopleSearch, SearchAsia, RecruitFirst, PeopleFirst, RecruitLegal, YesPay!, Performance Consulting, HRnetRimbun, REForce, CENTER Point PERSONNEL, and Young Talent brands. The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Singapore. HRnetGroup Limited is a subsidiary of SIMCO Ltd.
